modules.title: Orientation
modules.summary: See where the course ends up, pick your language, and get comfortable with the workspace.

lessons.title: Welcome to TEACH-ME-AI
lessons.summary: Draw a digit and watch a convolutional neural network read it. By the end of the course you will have built one from scratch.

lessons.title: How this course works
lessons.summary: Lessons, visualizations, exercises, and the library of functions you build along the way.

modules.title: Linear Algebra
modules.summary: Vectors, matrices and tensors: the data structures every neural network is made of.

lessons.title: Vectors
lessons.summary: Arrows, lists of numbers, and the two basic operations: adding and scaling.

lessons.title: The dot product & length
lessons.summary: The single most important operation in deep learning, and what it says about angles.

lessons.title: Matrices as transformations
lessons.summary: A matrix is a function that moves every point in space. Multiply one by a vector and see where it lands.

lessons.title: Matrix multiplication
lessons.summary: Chaining transformations, and the row-times-column rule behind every layer of a network.

lessons.title: Tensors, shapes & strides
lessons.summary: How a stack of images becomes one flat block of memory, and how to find any element in it.

lessons.title: Element-wise ops & broadcasting
lessons.summary: Operations that work entry by entry, and the stretching rule that adds a bias to every row.

modules.title: Calculus
modules.summary: Derivatives tell a network which way to adjust its weights. The chain rule is how it works that out.

lessons.title: Derivatives: the slope of a curve
lessons.summary: Zoom in on any smooth curve until it looks straight. Its slope there is the derivative.

lessons.title: Derivative rules & the sigmoid
lessons.summary: The handful of rules that let you differentiate by hand, applied to the sigmoid activation.

lessons.title: The chain rule
lessons.summary: Differentiating functions of functions: the idea backpropagation is built on.

lessons.title: Partial derivatives & gradients
lessons.summary: Functions of many variables, and the arrow that points uphill.

lessons.title: Gradient checking
lessons.summary: How to know your hand-derived gradients are right before you train on them.

modules.title: Probability & Statistics
modules.summary: Turning a network's raw scores into probabilities, and measuring how wrong they are.

modules.title: Optimization
modules.summary: Walking downhill on a loss surface, one gradient step at a time.

modules.title: Neural Networks
modules.summary: Layers of neurons, backpropagation, and your first MNIST classifier.

modules.title: Convolutional Neural Networks
modules.summary: Sliding filters that detect edges, then shapes, then digits.

modules.title: Capstone: MNIST CNN
modules.summary: Load the real dataset, train your own CNN to about 99%, and test it on your own handwriting.
planned: Draw a digit with your own model
